held.title: A top-level `import psycopg` stops the whole test module loading under psycopg2.
held.body: The migration under test handles both drivers: it reads `sqlstate` for psycopg and `pgcode` for psycopg2. That suggests psycopg2 may still be a supported setup. This module now imports `psycopg` (v3) at the top. On a setup that has only psycopg2, the import raises `ModuleNotFoundError`. The whole module then fails to load, including the existing history index tests that never need psycopg, and the new test fails instead of skipping. I could not check which drivers the project supports. If psycopg2 is supported, import psycopg inside the new test and skip when the import fails, or use `unittest.skipUnless`.
